name: ItemBlueprintOrigin - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: One place in an item blueprint's history: where it is produced, or a later place that altered it. Opened by Create New Join Entry on the item blueprint form's Origin step.

steps.description: Pick the place and its position in the item's history. The blueprint is the one you are editing.

fields.label: Place
fields.description: The town, district or structure. The first entry's name and type appear in the item's lore.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: 0 = where the item is produced (the only entry most items need); 1, 2, ... = later places that altered it, in that order. Each number can be used once per item.
